Available internal storage is %1$d MiB. Audio packs are limited to 1500 MiB and timing packs to 40 MiB. In Recitation you can keep up to eight audio packs, choose a reciter, or remove an inactive pack. Recordings are imported separately.
Images are processed locally. Audio and timing files stay in private app storage. Cloud backup is disabled. You can remove app data in Android settings.
Bundled Arabic OCR model is tessdata_fast (ara.traineddata), licensed under Apache 2.0.

Allow camera access, hold the page steady in good light, and tap to focus. Drag over the preview to select a scan area. Supported cameras offer exposure controls. You can scan a photo manually while automatic scanning is paused.
Choose a sharp image on your device. The scanner reads rotation from EXIF. Drag to select the text or scan the whole image.
Every scan result needs review. Compare the complete canonical verse with your printed page and check its surah and ayah before pressing Play. Playback always requires your action.

Import a legally obtained ZIP of ayah MP3 files. Word playback also requires reviewed timings for the exact recordings and text. Playback or highlighting is unavailable when required files are missing or mismatched.
Testing on physical Android devices and accuracy evaluation on Pakistani and Madani pages are pending. The Arabic text uses Tanzil Uthmani v1.1.

Arabic OCR uses Tesseract4Android and tessdata_fast (Apache 2.0). The canonical Quran text is Tanzil Uthmani v1.1 (CC BY 3.0), https://tanzil.net. The app includes the original text with integrity checks. Independent scholarly review and review of rendering are pending. Audio and reviewed word timings are imported separately.
Full image selected. Scan a photo or wait for automatic scanning.
Quran text uses Tanzil Uthmani v1.1. Import an audio pack to listen. Scans always require manual review before playback.
File checksums verify file integrity. Human review is required for the reciter, pronunciation, vowel marks and word timings.
